name: crmtool
description: CRM Tool monorepo — Next.js frontend + Express backend

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c teal,cyan "npm run dev -w crmtool-backend" "npm run dev -w crmtool-frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev -w crmtool-backend
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev -w crmtool-frontend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w crmtool-backend && npm run build -w crmtool-frontend
scripts.start:backend: node init && npm run start -w crmtool-backend
scripts.start:frontend: node init && npm run start -w crmtool-frontend
